layout: cmd/acme-api: main package, wires Server and starts http.ListenAndServe on :8080
internal/validation: pure validation functions, no I/O
internal/store: in-memory user store behind Store interface
naming: Exported identifiers use CamelCase; unexported use camelCase
Validation error codes are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE string constants in package validation
Test functions are named Test<FunctionName>; table cases have a name field
conventions.errors: Validation returns *validation.ValidationError. All other failures return error wrapped with fmt.Errorf("context: %w", err). Handlers map *ValidationError to 400, store.ErrEmailTaken to 409, anything else to 500.
conventions.logging: log/slog with the default text handler. Never log request bodies.
conventions.testing: Table-driven tests in the same package. Use net/http/httptest for handlers. Use a fake http.RoundTripper for the CRM client.

types.decl:
const (
	CodeEmailRequired  = "EMAIL_REQUIRED"
	CodeEmailInvalid   = "EMAIL_INVALID"
	CodeEmailTooLong   = "EMAIL_TOO_LONG"
	CodeUsernameLength = "USERNAME_LENGTH"
	CodeUsernameChars  = "USERNAME_CHARS"
)

functions.doc: Error returns Field and Message joined with a colon.
ValidateEmail trims the input and returns nil when it is a syntactically valid address of at most 254 characters with a dotted domain.
ValidateUsername returns nil when the input is 3 to 32 characters of a-z, 0-9, and underscore.
NewMemory returns an empty in-memory Store safe for concurrent use.

functions.signature: func (m *Memory) Create(ctx context.Context, email, username string) (User, error)
functions.doc: Create lowercases and trims email, rejects duplicates with ErrEmailTaken, assigns a UUID v4 ID and UTC CreatedAt.

functions.signature: func (c *Client) Push(ctx context.Context, u store.User) error
functions.doc: Push POSTs the user to the CRM contacts endpoint with a bearer token. Returns an error on non-2xx or transport failure.
New returns a Client. A nil httpClient uses http.DefaultClient with a 2 second timeout.
NewServer wires dependencies. CRM is a one-method interface satisfied by *crm.Client.
HandleRegister decodes the body, validates, creates the user, pushes to CRM best effort, and writes the JSON response.
HandleHealthz writes 200 and the body ok.
Routes returns a ServeMux with POST /register and GET /healthz registered.
main builds the store, CRM client from CRM_API_KEY, the server, and listens on :8080.

integration_tests.name: register valid user
integration_tests.given: POST /register with a@b.co and abc against NewServer with memory store and fake CRM
integration_tests.expect: 201 and JSON with id, email, username

integration_tests.name: crm failure does not fail registration
integration_tests.expect: register still returns 201 and a warn log line
